name: button
useFor: Use one default (ink hexagon) button per view for the main action (Start building), outline for the action beside it (Download for macOS), secondary for a quieter action inside content, ghost for nav items and toolbar glyphs, and link for an inline action in text. size sm is the 32px header key. Use type="submit" in forms, or asChild (or render) with a link for navigation. A glyph goes before the label at 16px (Phosphor, regular weight).
constraints: Two ink hexagons side by side
An icon that moves on hover
source: The Hoplite website's .button, .button--primary, .button--line and .button--s (hoplite-website-fawn.vercel.app: Start building, Download for macOS, Start team, Start free) and its nav items (.hn__top)
title: Button
description: The hexagonal key: the 40px ink hexagon for the main action, the outlined hexagon for the second, a hexagon of the hover wash, a bare nav label whose compact hexagon appears under the pointer, and the underlined link. 32px keys cut their ends 8px; a key takes its pressed fill the instant it is pressed.
